items.name: Access Token
items.description: A forged session token. Presents itself to a non-critical server and grants user-level access, skipping the password.

items.name: Encryption Key
items.description: A master key fragment for NEXUS ciphers. Every encryption puzzle gives you one extra free hint.

items.name: Firewall Bypass Chip
items.description: A burner chip that rewrites firewall rules for a few seconds. Use it on a protected server to skip the mini-game.

items.name: Data Fragment
items.short: Collect 4 to forge a Quantum Key
items.description: A shard of something much larger. Four fragments can be fused with 'use data_fragment'.

items.name: Anonymous Credential
items.description: A credential that belongs to nobody. Required by some high-security hosts; 'use' it to cool the trace alert (3 min recharge).

items.name: Trace Module
items.description: Dedicated hardware for stream analysis. Slows trace data streams and forgives one more mistake.

items.name: Quantum Key
items.description: A key that exists in several states at once. Some NEXUS locks only recognise this.

upgrades.name: FIREWALL ANALYSIS
upgrades.description: Extra firewall attempts; LV5 reveals a symbol.

upgrades.name: ENCRYPTION
upgrades.description: Mistakes raise the trace alert less.

upgrades.name: TRACE
upgrades.description: Slower trace streams and more forgiveness.

upgrades.name: NETWORK ACCESS
upgrades.description: Bigger routing budget; richer scan details.
